description: Hydropower development in the Lower Mekong Basin (LMB) is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. A brief about hydropower in the Mekong, describing the hydropower potential and the major tasks of the Mekong River Commission in hydropower development. The report describes the energy situation in Mekong countries, existing hydropower projects, and provides a SWOT analysis. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Energy, Energy for transport, Rivers and lakes. It offers 1 resource(s) in pdf. The portal shows 2016-12-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
